page.title: 感じる動詞・伝える動詞

analysis.summaryJa: taste・smell・feelは、こちらから確かめにいく能動的な動作にも、味・におい・感触・感情がこちらへ入ってくる感覚にも使える。一方、speak・talk・say・tellは『話す』の焦点が異なり、speakは音声を発する・言語を話す、talkは相手とのやり取り、sayは発言内容、tellは相手へ情報を渡すことに焦点がある。目的語や前置詞、補文の形を手掛かりに自然な動詞を選ぶ。
grammarPoints: taste/smell/feelは他動詞で意図的に確かめる動作を表せる
taste/smell/feel + 形容詞で、主語から受ける感覚・状態を表す
speakは話す行為や言語能力に焦点を置き、speak to/with + 人、speak + 言語を取る
talkは双方向の会話に焦点を置き、talk to/with + 人、talk about + 話題を使う
sayは発言内容を目的語に取りやすく、say that節やsay + 引用内容を使う
tellは情報の受け手を直接目的語に取り、tell + 人 + 内容 / to不定詞が基本。tell to 人とはしない
visualEvidence: 左側の『自分から確かめる↔感覚が入る』切替がtaste/smell/feelの二面性を示す
右側の4本の矢印がspeak＝音声、talk＝やり取り、say＝内容、tell＝相手への情報という焦点差を示す
tell me the routeの例がtellの受け手目的語を強調する
talkのミニ確認が双方向のやり取りを選択基準にすることを示す
commonTraps: taste/smell/feelの後に副詞を置き、感覚の補語として必要な形容詞を使えない
speakとtalkを完全同義と考え、言語能力・会話の焦点を区別しない
say meやtell to meのようにsayとtellの目的語構造を混同する
talk a topicとし、talk about + 話題を忘れる
speak aboutとtalk aboutが成立しうる場面でも、問題文の焦点を見ずに機械的に選ぶ
tell + 人 + to doとsay + that節の形を混同する

questions.prompt: Please ------- the sample sauce before approving the recipe for the café.
questions.translationJa: カフェ用レシピを承認する前に、試作品のソースを味見してください。
questions.explanationJa: 自分から味を確かめる意図的な動作なのでtasteが適切です。
questions.focus: taste＝意図的に味を確かめる

questions.prompt: The meeting room ------- unusually warm after the ventilation system shuts down.
questions.translationJa: 換気設備が停止した後、その会議室は異常に暖かく感じられます。
questions.explanationJa: feel + 形容詞で、主語から受ける感覚を表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Kim can ------- Spanish with visitors from our Madrid office.
questions.translationJa: キムさんはマドリード支社からの来訪者とスペイン語を話せます。
questions.explanationJa: 言語能力を表すときはspeak + 言語を使います。

questions.prompt: We need to ------- with the supplier about the revised delivery schedule.
questions.translationJa: 私たちは改訂された納入日程について仕入先と話し合う必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 相手との双方向のやり取りなのでtalk with + 人 + about + 話題が自然です。

questions.prompt: The notice ------- that the east entrance will be closed after 6 p.m.
questions.translationJa: その通知には、午後6時以降は東入口が閉鎖されると書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: 発言・表示の内容をthat節で示すのでsaysが適切です。

questions.prompt: Could you ------- me whether breakfast is included in the room rate?
questions.translationJa: 朝食が宿泊料金に含まれているか教えてもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: tellは情報の受け手meを直接目的語に取れます。

questions.prompt: The storage area ------- of fresh paint because the walls were repainted yesterday.
questions.translationJa: 壁を昨日塗り直したため、保管エリアは新しい塗料のにおいがします。
questions.explanationJa: smell of + 名詞で、そのにおいが感じられることを表します。

questions.prompt: The new fabric ------- softer than the material used in last year's uniforms.
questions.translationJa: 新しい生地は昨年の制服に使われた素材より柔らかく感じられます。
questions.explanationJa: 触覚で受ける印象をfeel + 形容詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The director ------- the audience that the new branch would open in November.
questions.translationJa: 取締役は聴衆に、新支店が11月に開業すると伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: tell + 人 + that節で、特定の相手へ情報を渡します。

questions.prompt: During the briefing, the consultant ------- about how the new regulations would affect hotel operators.
questions.translationJa: 説明会でコンサルタントは、新しい規則がホテル運営者にどう影響するかについて話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一方向にまとまった内容を話す場面ではspoke aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about deliberately checking the flavor of a drink.

choices.A: The chef tasted sweet the coffee before serving it.
choices.B: The chef spoke the coffee before serving it.
choices.C: The chef tasted the coffee before serving it.
choices.D: The chef told the coffee before serving it.

questions.translationJa: シェフは提供する前にコーヒーを味見しました。
questions.explanationJa: tasteは目的語the coffeeを取り、意図的に味を確かめる他動詞として使えます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about how a surface seems to the touch.

choices.A: The new countertop feels smooth and durable.
choices.B: The new countertop feels smoothly and durable.
choices.C: The new countertop tells smooth and durable.
choices.D: The new countertop talks smooth and durable.

questions.translationJa: 新しいカウンター天板は滑らかで丈夫な感触です。
questions.explanationJa: feelの後には感覚を表す形容詞smooth, durableを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about language ability.

choices.A: Mr. Alvarez talks both English and Portuguese.
choices.B: Mr. Alvarez speaks both English and Portuguese.
choices.C: Mr. Alvarez says both English and Portuguese.
choices.D: Mr. Alvarez tells both English and Portuguese.

questions.translationJa: アルバレスさんは英語とポルトガル語の両方を話します。
questions.explanationJa: 言語能力はspeak + 言語で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about discussing a service problem with a manager.

choices.A: I talked the front-desk manager the complaint.
choices.B: I said with the front-desk manager about the complaint.
choices.C: I told about the front-desk manager the complaint.
choices.D: I talked with the front-desk manager about the complaint.

questions.translationJa: 私は苦情についてフロント責任者と話し合いました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手との会話はtalk with + 人、話題はaboutで示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the content of an email.

choices.A: The email tells that our reservation has been confirmed.
choices.B: The email says us that our reservation has been confirmed.
choices.C: The email says that our reservation has been confirmed.
choices.D: The email talks that our reservation has been confirmed.

questions.translationJa: メールには予約が確認済みだと書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: 内容そのものに焦点を置くのでsay + that節が自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about giving an instruction to a trainee.

choices.A: The supervisor told the trainee to wear protective gloves.
choices.B: The supervisor said the trainee to wear protective gloves.
choices.C: The supervisor told to the trainee to wear protective gloves.
choices.D: The supervisor talked the trainee to wear protective gloves.

questions.translationJa: 監督者は研修生に保護手袋を着用するよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: tell + 人 + to不定詞で、相手へ指示を渡します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about the odor of a room.

choices.A: The lobby smells freshly after the carpets are cleaned.
choices.B: The lobby smells fresh after the carpets are cleaned.
choices.C: The lobby smells the fresh after the carpets are cleaned.
choices.D: The lobby tells fresh after the carpets are cleaned.

questions.translationJa: カーペット清掃後、ロビーはさわやかなにおいがします。
questions.explanationJa: smell + 形容詞で、主語から感じるにおいの性質を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about exchanging ideas on a topic.

choices.A: The engineers talked several ways to reduce noise.
choices.B: The engineers said about several ways to reduce noise.
choices.C: The engineers told about several ways to reduce noise each other.
choices.D: The engineers talked about several ways to reduce noise.

questions.translationJa: 技術者たちは騒音を減らすいくつかの方法について話し合いました。
questions.explanationJa: 双方向の話し合いで話題を示すのでtalk aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about quoting exact spoken content.

choices.A: Ms. Wong told, "The shuttle leaves at six."
choices.B: Ms. Wong said us, "The shuttle leaves at six."
choices.C: Ms. Wong said, "The shuttle leaves at six."
choices.D: Ms. Wong talked, "The shuttle leaves at six."

questions.translationJa: ウォンさんは「シャトルは6時に出発します」と言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 発言内容そのものを引用する場合はsaidが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about informing a specific applicant.

choices.A: Please say the applicant that the interview time has changed.
choices.B: Please tell the applicant that the interview time has changed.
choices.C: Please tell to the applicant that the interview time has changed.
choices.D: Please talk the applicant that the interview time has changed.

questions.translationJa: 応募者に面接時刻が変更されたと伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: tellは受け手the applicantを直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: The technician deliberately checked the odor near the vent. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The technician said the air near the vent to check the odor.
choices.B: The technician talked the air near the vent to check the odor.
choices.C: The technician told the air near the vent to check the odor.
choices.D: The technician smelled the air near the vent to check the odor.

questions.translationJa: 技術者はにおいを確認するため、通気口の近くの空気を嗅ぎました。
questions.explanationJa: 意図してにおいを確かめる動作はsmellを他動詞で使って表せます。

questions.prompt: The fabric seems rough to the touch. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.D: The fabric tells rough to the hand.

questions.translationJa: その生地はざらざらした感触です。
questions.explanationJa: 触覚上の印象はfeel + 形容詞で表せます。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito is able to use French in conversation. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.
questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんはフランス語を話せます。
questions.explanationJa: 言語能力を表すのでcan speak Frenchが同義です。

questions.prompt: The two managers discussed the staffing plan together. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The two managers said the staffing plan together.
choices.B: The two managers talked about the staffing plan.
choices.C: The two managers told about the staffing plan without an object.
choices.D: The two managers spoke the staffing plan as a language.

questions.translationJa: 2人の管理者は人員計画について話し合いました。
questions.explanationJa: discussed togetherは双方向のtalked aboutで自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The sign indicates that food is not allowed in the gallery. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The sign tells that food is not allowed in the gallery.
choices.B: The sign says visitors that food is not allowed in the gallery.
choices.C: The sign talks food is not allowed in the gallery.
choices.D: The sign says that food is not allowed in the gallery.

questions.translationJa: その表示にはギャラリー内で飲食は禁止だと書かれています。
questions.explanationJa: 表示内容に焦点を置くindicatesはsays thatで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The agent informed me that the later flight was full. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The agent said me that the later flight was full.
choices.B: The agent told to me that the later flight was full.
choices.C: The agent told me that the later flight was full.
choices.D: The agent talked me that the later flight was full.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は私に、後の便は満席だと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: inform + 人は、tell + 人 + 内容で同じ情報移動を表せます。

questions.prompt: The soup has a slightly salty flavor. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.
questions.translationJa: そのスープは少し塩辛い味がします。
questions.explanationJa: 味の性質はtaste + 形容詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The presenter addressed the audience about the new safety program. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The presenter said to the audience the safety program as a language.
choices.B: The presenter spoke to the audience about the new safety program.
choices.C: The presenter told about the audience the new safety program.
choices.D: The presenter tasted the audience about the new safety program.

questions.translationJa: 発表者は聴衆に新しい安全プログラムについて話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一方向に聴衆へ話すaddressedはspoke to ... about ...で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The customer stated that the package had arrived damaged. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The customer told that the package had arrived damaged.
choices.B: The customer said the agent that the package had arrived damaged.
choices.C: The customer talked that the package had arrived damaged.
choices.D: The customer said that the package had arrived damaged.

questions.translationJa: 顧客は荷物が破損した状態で届いたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: statedは発言内容に焦点を置くsaid thatで自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The coordinator instructed us to wait near the information desk. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The coordinator said us to wait near the information desk.
choices.B: The coordinator told to us wait near the information desk.
choices.C: The coordinator told us to wait near the information desk.
choices.D: The coordinator talked us to wait near the information desk.

questions.translationJa: 担当者は私たちに案内所の近くで待つよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: instruct + 人 + to doはtell + 人 + to doで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The sample tea is a new blend. Please ------- it and note whether the flavor is too strong.
questions.translationJa: その試飲用のお茶は新しいブレンドです。味見して、味が強すぎないか記録してください。
questions.explanationJa: 自分から味を確かめる動作なのでtasteを使います。

questions.prompt: The meeting room has just been cleaned. It ------- fresh, so we can open it for visitors now.
questions.translationJa: 会議室は清掃されたばかりです。さわやかなにおいがするので、来訪者に開放できます。
questions.explanationJa: においの性質はsmell + 形容詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The overseas guest does not read Japanese, but Ms. Sato can ------- English and explain the emergency procedure.
questions.translationJa: 海外からの来客は日本語を読めませんが、佐藤さんは英語を話して緊急手順を説明できます。
questions.explanationJa: 言語能力を表すのでspeak Englishが正しい形です。

questions.prompt: We have two possible delivery dates. Let's ------- with the warehouse manager and decide which one works best.
questions.translationJa: 納入日は2つの候補があります。倉庫責任者と話し合って、最適な日を決めましょう。
questions.explanationJa: 相手とやり取りしながら決めるのでtalk withが適切です。

questions.prompt: The website ------- that refunds are processed within five business days, but the customer has already waited a week.
questions.translationJa: ウェブサイトには返金は5営業日以内に処理されるとありますが、顧客はすでに1週間待っています。
questions.explanationJa: ウェブサイトに記載された内容を示すのでsays thatが自然です。

questions.prompt: The applicant asked whether the interview would be online. Please ------- her that it will be held in Conference Room B.
questions.translationJa: 応募者は面接がオンラインか尋ねました。会議室Bで行われると彼女に伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 情報の受け手herを直接目的語に取るtellが必要です。

questions.prompt: The new chair has extra lumbar support. When you sit in it, the backrest ------- much firmer than the old model.
questions.translationJa: 新しい椅子には腰部サポートがあります。座ると背もたれは旧型よりかなりしっかり感じられます。
questions.explanationJa: 触覚の印象をfeel + 形容詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The issue affects several departments, so a one-way announcement is not enough. The managers need to ------- with one another before deciding.
questions.translationJa: この問題は複数部署に関係するため、一方向の発表だけでは不十分です。管理者同士で決定前に話し合う必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 相互のやり取りが必要なのでtalk with one anotherが適切です。

questions.prompt: At the opening ceremony, the president ------- about the company's plans for sustainable logistics.
questions.translationJa: 開所式で社長は、持続可能な物流に関する会社の計画について話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 式典で聴衆へまとまった内容を話す一方向の発話なのでspoke aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: The receptionist did not simply announce the delay; she ------- each guest that the shuttle would arrive twenty minutes late.
questions.translationJa: 受付担当者は単に遅延を発表しただけでなく、各来客にシャトルが20分遅れると伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 受け手each guestへ個別に情報を渡したのでtoldが適切です。
